Data Model : Assassin is a key/value store that supports mapping a key to its corresponding value.

System Architecture : The DAT protocol distributes and hosts data between many computers, so there is no one location where data is stored. Assassin relies on the the DAT protocol for data persistence. The metadata of the key-value pairs are stored in a distributed trie structure.
Isolation Levels : The isolation level is determined by the end user of the database. Assassin is designed to have a low isolation level.

Storage Model : Assassin sends data to the server, which then stores the metadata in the distributed file system Hyperdrive, which is built on the DAT protocol. The data itself is distributed and hosted between multiple peers.

|**The backbone**|`pdtm` (the orchestration of the 4 stages of the active mapping) + `daily` (the cron + the diff of the snapshots + the local dashboard) + `manage` (the entry of the businesses)|installed by default, it runs on its own|
|**An optional plugin**|`katana` (the scan of the URL assets) + `health` (the health checks of the operation) + `notify` (the encrypted push of the report)|self deployed, self enabled|

|**A separate repository**|`srcradar-algo-diff-cpp` (the C++ core of the judgement of a change) + `srcradar-mcp-server` (the MCP adapter for the local agents)|installed beside the tree, the sources are not shared|
|**The shared data**|a single SQLite (`db/recon.sqlite3`) connects every output|

The installation / the use / the operation of the optional plugins are in the README of each of them: `katana/README.md` · `health/README.md` · `notify/README.md`. **It is for the authorized scenarios only** (see the prerequisites and the compliance below). This tool **only collects information**, it does not exploit anything.

> **The plugins of the domestic registries**: `db_align` (the graph of the legal entities, it marks the LOCKED tag) and `ymicp` (the reverse lookup of the filing of the mini programs / of the WeChat accounts) read the Chinese corporate and the ICP registries, so they work only for the targets of China. Their documentation is `db_align/README.md` · `ymicp/README.md`. The backbone does not need them: the scopes come from an input directory or from a seed TSV.

The whole legal terms are in `LICENSE` (Apache-2.0) + `TERMS_ADDENDUM.md` (the additional restrictions of the use and the disclaimer) + `NOTICE` (the thanks to the upstream, and the notices of the optional plugins).

> **The convention of the entry points**: `check.sh` and `install.sh` are the entry points of the refactoring of 2026-09; the old `init.sh` only keeps the two standalone tool entries `--init-db` / `--check-schema` (see the daily operation).

> **Where it is installed**: pdtm is installed into `~/go/bin/`; the tool chain of PD (dnsx/httpx/subfinder/alterx/naabu/cdncheck) is managed by pdtm in `~/.pdtm/go/bin/`; the empty database `db/recon.sqlite3` is created at the end of install.sh. See the comment at the top of `install.sh`.

|`modules/main/pdtm`|**the active mapping**: the orchestration of the 4 stages (the wildcard resolution → the enumeration and the derivation of the subdomains → the judgement of the CDN + the scan of the ports + the probe of the web → the import into the SQLite)|the tool chain of ProjectDiscovery, it is called, not forked; README|

|`modules/main/lib`|**the shared helpers**: the parser of `config/*.conf`, the forwarder of the language lookup, the resolver of the DNS resolver list|every module of the tree reaches it through the same short path|

|`modules/main/daily`|**the daily operation**: the cron, the snapshot of the tables, the diff of the snapshots and the local dashboard|the dashboard binds 127.0.0.1 only, its 4 tabs are Task Status / Site Details / Port Services / Risk Level; README|
|`modules/main/manage`|**the entry of the businesses**: the registration of a business, the switches of a business, the seeds, the language and the resolver set|the scripts of the operator; README|
|`modules/main/db`|**the shared data**: the creation of the SQLite and the incremental migrations of the schema|`db/recon.sqlite3`, the mode WAL + a busy_timeout of 5s|

|`modules/main/i18n`|**the language of the output**: the message tables of the user-visible output and the gate that keeps them consistent|the zh and the en tables, the check of the placeholders and of the bodies; README|
|`modules/public/katana`|**the plugin of the URL assets**: the scan at the granularity of the URL|optional, self deployed; README|

|`modules/public/health`|**the plugin of the operation**: the health checks of the disk / of the CPU / of the memory / of the cron / of the dashboard|optional, it pushes through the plugin of the notification; README|
|`modules/public/notify`|**the plugin of the push**: the encrypted report of the day, sent to the mailbox of the operator|optional, the body is encrypted with GPG; README|

|`srcradar-algo-diff-cpp`|**the judgement of a change**: the C++ core that decides, for every asset, whether it changed since the day before|a repository of its own, the tree calls its binary, the sources are not shared|

|`srcradar-mcp-server`|**the adapter for the agents**: it exposes the commands of the tree over the MCP protocol, so a local agent calls them over HTTP instead of opening a session on the host|a repository of its own, it holds no data of the businesses, it only forwards the calls|
|`businesses`|the dictionary of the SRC businesses (`id`, `business_name`)|anybody, it is unique by `business_name`|
|`recon_business_config`|the switches of the stages of a business (`business_id`, `enabled`, `web`, `tcp`, `icp`)|a manual SQL; `daily_monitor.sh` reads it and filters by business|
|`scopes`|the whitelist of the measurable and of the assets that are not measurable|**`pdtm finalize_scope`** / **`manage/scope_import.sh`** (2 independent paths, any of them is enough)|
|`web_subdomains` / `web_hashes`|the web assets + the library of the fingerprints|`pdtm/import_scan_results.py`|
